_doc: Esther voice cast and per-line direction, read by tools/story/voice.py (see its docstring and docs/esther/VOICE.md). engine 'edge' = Microsoft neural voices via edge-tts (rate/pitch are prosody values); engine 'qwen' = Qwen3-TTS run locally (voice = speaker, instruct = acting note). fx: plain, warm, nasal, offstage. chain: expressive (TTS at -16 LUFS, gentle compressor) unless stated. lines.<id>.<lang>.phrases speaks the line in phrases joined by `gap` seconds of silence.

narrator.instruct: 一位温暖的女讲故事人，像妈妈给四到十岁的孩子讲圣经故事，声音亲切、生动、自然，语速正常流畅，不拖沓。这一句：

esther.instruct: 一位年轻的王后，温柔、善良、勇敢，像真人在演儿童广播剧，自然不做作，语速正常流畅。这一句：

king.instruct: 一位声音低沉、说话从容的国王，平静时很和蔼，像真人在演儿童广播剧，语速正常。这一句：

es_01.m: 讲故事的开头，温暖、不急，带一点神秘；说名字前停一下
es_01.d: 画面：睡前，你翻开一本大图画书，孩子靠在你身边。
es_01.m_en: storyteller opening; warm, unhurried, a little mysterious; small pause before the name
es_01.d_en: Picture: bedtime, a big picture book open, the child leaning on you.

phrases.text: in the city of Susa, there lived a very powerful king.

es_02.m: 温柔、带着笑；说到她的名字时放慢
es_02.d: 画面：你在给孩子介绍一位你很喜欢的人。
es_02.m_en: tender, smiling; slow down on her name
es_02.d_en: Picture: you are introducing someone you love.

phrases.text: The king chose a beautiful, kind young woman to be his queen.

es_03.m: 神气、有点鼻音、很得意；开头哼一声；滑稽，不吓人
es_03.d: 画面：你挺着肚子，下巴抬得高高的，等着别人鞠躬。
es_03.m_en: puffed-up, nasal, pleased with himself; a sniff at the start; comic, not scary
es_03.d_en: Picture: chest out, chin up, waiting for everyone to bow.

phrases.text: 我可是王最看重的大臣！
谁见了我，都得弯腰下拜！
I am the king's most important man!
Everyone must bow down to me!

es_04.m: 平平地讲，说到跺脚时有点好笑
es_04.d: 画面：你在学一个生气的人跺脚，孩子在笑。
es_04.m_en: matter-of-fact, then a little amused on the stomping
es_04.d_en: Picture: you act out someone stomping; the child giggles.

phrases.text: But Mordecai bowed only to God, not to Haman.
Haman stomped his feet in anger!

es_05.m: 小声、慢、油滑；两次鬼鬼祟祟的停顿
es_05.d: 画面：你凑到别人耳边说悄悄话，眼睛还往两边看。
es_05.m_en: sly half-whisper, slow, oily; two sneaky pauses
es_05.d_en: Picture: whispering in someone's ear, eyes darting left and right.

phrases.text: 有一群人，不守您的规矩。
不如……让我把他们都除掉吧？
there are some people who don't keep your laws.
Why not... let me get rid of them?

es_06.m: 低沉、随便、有点无聊；先“嗯……”想一想
es_06.d: 画面：你懒洋洋地坐在大椅子上，随手把东西递出去。
es_06.m_en: deep, careless, a little bored; a thinking 'hmm' first
es_06.d_en: Picture: slumped in a big chair, handing something over without looking.

phrases.text: very well. Take my ring. Do as you see fit.

es_07.m: 年长的男人，着急但充满爱；从远处喊来；最后一句放慢
es_07.d: 画面：你站在门外，隔着门对你疼爱的孩子说话。
es_07.m_en: older man, urgent but loving, from a distance; slower on the last sentence
es_07.d_en: Picture: outside a door, speaking through it to someone you love.

phrases.text: 以斯帖，你要去求王救我们！
说不定，你当上王后，就是为了今天！
Esther, you must ask the king to save us!
Maybe this is why you became queen, for a time just like this!

es_08.m: 害怕、小声、犹豫；“可是”前吸一口气
es_08.d: 画面：你很想帮忙，可是心里怕得发抖。
es_08.d_en: Picture: you want to help, but you are shaking inside.

phrases.text: anyone who goes to the king without being called could die...

es_09.m: 深吸一口气，然后稳稳地、勇敢地说；越说越坚定，最后最有力
es_09.d: 画面：你擦干眼泪，站起来，下定决心。
es_09.m_en: a deep breath, then steady and brave; rising resolve, strongest on the last words
es_09.d_en: Picture: you wipe your tears, stand up and decide.

phrases.text: I will go to the king, even if it's dangerous!

es_10.m: 压低声音、紧张、慢；问句悬在那里
es_10.d: 画面：你讲到最紧张的地方，孩子屏住呼吸。
es_10.m_en: hushed, suspenseful, slow; let the question hang
es_10.d_en: Picture: the scariest part of the story; the child holds their breath.

phrases.text: Step by step, Esther climbed the palace stairs...

es_11.m: 先惊讶，然后温暖、大方；声音里带着笑
es_11.d: 画面：你看见心爱的人突然来了，很高兴。
es_11.m_en: surprised, then warm and generous; a smile in the voice
es_11.d_en: Picture: someone you love turns up by surprise and you are glad.

phrases.text: What is it you want? Even half my kingdom, it's yours!

es_12.m: 有礼貌、甜、有点小聪明；轻快
es_12.d: 画面：你笑眯眯地请人来家里吃饭，心里有个计划。
es_12.m_en: polite, sweet, a little clever; light
es_12.d_en: Picture: inviting someone to dinner with a smile, a plan in mind.

phrases.text: My king, will you come to my banquet?

es_13.m: 发抖但勇敢；说到“我的族人”时声音哽一下
es_13.d: 画面：你鼓起勇气说出一件让你很难过的事。
es_13.m_en: trembling but brave; voice catches on 'my people'
es_13.d_en: Picture: you find the courage to say something that hurts.

es_14.m: 又惊又气，大声但不是吼；短促有力
es_14.d: 画面：你听说有人欺负你最爱的人。
es_14.m_en: shocked and angry, loud but not shouting; short sharp phrases
es_14.d_en: Picture: you hear someone has been hurting the person you love most.

es_15.m: 清楚、坚定；说“哈曼”前停一拍，鼓起勇气
es_15.d: 画面：你伸出手指，指着做坏事的人。
es_15.m_en: clear and firm, a beat of courage before 'Haman'
es_15.d_en: Picture: you point straight at the one who did wrong.

es_16.d: 画面：你被抓个正着，吓得跳了起来。
es_16.d_en: Picture: caught red-handed, you jump in fright.

es_17.m: 先松一口气，然后很开心；开心的部分快一点
es_17.d: 画面：故事的危险过去了，你和孩子一起拍手。
es_17.m_en: relief, then bright joy; speed up a little on the happy part
es_17.d_en: Picture: the danger is over; you and the child clap together.

phrases.text: The king had Haman taken away.
Everyone sang and danced for joy!

es_18.m: 温暖的结尾，直接对孩子说；“你也可以哦”带着笑
es_18.d: 画面：你看着孩子的眼睛，轻轻摸摸他的头。
es_18.m_en: warm moral, speaking right to the child; smile on 'You can too'
es_18.d_en: Picture: you look the child in the eyes and stroke their hair.

phrases.text: Esther was scared, but she chose to be brave and to trust God.
